title: Cleopatra Is Closer to the Moon Landing Than the Pyramids 🚀 #shorts
description:
The Great Pyramid of Giza was finished around 2560 BC. Cleopatra died in 30 BC – about 2,500 years later. Apollo 11 landed on the Moon in 1969 – only about 2,000 years after her. So Cleopatra lived closer to the Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid!

Sources: WorldAtlas, IFLScience, Smithsonian

#shorts #facts #crazyfacts #history #didyouknow #egypt

scenes.headline:
CLEOPATRA
VS THE
MOON LANDING

scenes.text: The Great Pyramid of Giza was finished around 2560 B.C., for the pharaoh Khufu.
Cleopatra, the last active ruler of ancient Egypt, died in 30 B.C.
That means the pyramid was already about 2,500 years old in her lifetime.
scenes.label: PYRAMID'S AGE IN HER TIME

scenes.text: Now jump forward. In 1969, Apollo 11 landed on the Moon.
From Cleopatra to the Moon: about 2,000 years. From the pyramid to Cleopatra: about 2,500.
Ancient Egypt was so old, it was ancient history even to the ancient Egyptians.
